name: JLCPCB SMT assembly
about: What JLCPCB's assembly line expects of a part: its pads checked against the EasyEDA footprint of the LCSC part number (the footprint JLCPCB places by), the CPL rotation that turns that footprint onto ours, and JLCPCB's BOM / CPL columns. Every rule names its source; docs/assembly.md explains each one.

jlc-cpl.title: JLCPCB Help: Pick & Place File for PCB Assembly
jlc-cpl.note: Designator, Mid X / Mid Y (the component centroid, mm), Layer (Top / Bottom), Rotation in degrees, positive counter-clockwise. Read 2026-10-18.

jlc-bom.title: JLCPCB Help: Bill of Materials (BOM) File for PCB Assembly
jlc-bom.note: Comment, Designator, Footprint; designators are upper-cased by JLCPCB. Read 2026-10-18.

jlc-kicad.title: JLCPCB Help: How To Export BOM and CPL Files From KiCad
jlc-kicad.note: BOM: Comment, Designator, Footprint and the JLCPCB / LCSC Part # (field 'LCSC Part #'); CPL: Designator, Mid X, Mid Y, Rotation, Layer in mm, from KiCad's .pos with renamed columns; rotations need correcting ('automatic component translations ... fixes part rotations/positions for JLCPCB'). Read 2026-10-18.

easyeda-footprints.title: kicad-jlcpcb-tools, jlcfootprint/README.md (MIT)
easyeda-footprints.note: JLCPCB places each part by the EasyEDA footprint of the LCSC part number; the turn that aligns the KiCad pads onto it is the CPL rotation. Their check of JLCPCB's placement preview: a SOIC-8 whose EasyEDA name ends -BL needs 270 deg on a KiCad footprint at 0 deg. Bottom side: the angle is read looking at the bottom (180 - KiCad's angle), then corrected the same way; the preview agrees on both sides.

kicad-pos.title: KiCad place file exporter (pcbnew/exporters/place_file_exporter.cpp)
kicad-pos.note: PosX / PosY from the footprint position with the Y axis turned to point up, Rot = the footprint's orientation, on both sides.

kicad-klc.title: KiCad Library Conventions F5/F6
kicad-klc.note: KiCad footprints: pin 1 top-left, numbers counter-clockwise; diodes / LEDs: cathode on pad 1; polarized capacitors: + on pad 1.

golden-set.title: ecadlib golden set (tests/fixtures/assembly, docs/assembly.md)
golden-set.note: The 0 deg pose of each family as JLCPCB's own (EasyEDA) footprints draw it, measured on the recorded parts listed in docs/assembly.md.

kjt-bom.title: kicad-jlcpcb-tools, bom_csv.py BOM_LINE_MAX_BYTES (MIT)
kjt-bom.note: JLCPCB rejects a BOM line longer than 2048 bytes (kicad-jlcpcb-tools issue #755: a long Designator cell); their exporter splits a group over several lines. Read 2026-10-19.

jlc-0402.title: r/KiCad, Mar 2026: JLCPCB rejected an order over KiCad vs EasyEDA 0402 pads
jlc-0402.note: A pad spacing that differs from the EasyEDA footprint's by about 18% (KiCad R_0402 1.02 mm against EasyEDA R0402 0.87 mm) was flagged by JLCPCB; KiCad's 0603 and larger chips sit within 11%.

origin.rule: the assembler's footprint origin is the placement centroid (Mid X / Mid Y)

top.rule: CPL rotation = board angle + Assembly Rotation

bottom.rule: the angle as seen from the bottom (KiCad: 180 - the board angle), + Assembly Rotation; Mid X / Mid Y stay top-view coordinates
bottom.confidence: community: kicad-jlcpcb-tools checked it on JLCPCB's placement preview; ecadlib has not had a bottom-side order yet

altium_bottom.rule: Altium mirrors a bottom-side part left-right: seen from the bottom its angle is 360 - the pick-and-place Rotation
altium_bottom.confidence: unverified: check bottom-side parts in JLCPCB's placement preview

tolerances.about: identical: every pad within identical_mm. risky: a pad off its land sideways by more than max(position_mm, position_share x the land's width), a width that differs by more than max(size_mm, size_share x width), less than min_overlap of their land covered by ours, or (two-pin parts) the pad spacing off by more than two_pin_span_share. incompatible: pin count or numbering differs, a mirror image fits, or a pad off its land sideways by more than max(incompatible_mm, half the land, incompatible_pitch_share x pitch), or wrong-size lands: the pad spacing (two pins: centre to centre; more: row to row, the extent of the pin centres along each axis) off by more than incompatible_span_share, or by more than two_pin_span_share with less than incompatible_span_cover of the worst land covered (calibrated on the golden set: its worst correct pairings are -24% row to row at 82% covered (SOT-23) and -19% at 65% covered (Kemet B); a 0603 resistor on an 0805 part is -18% at 48%).

led_chip.measured: cathode on the left on 7 / 7 golden-set parts

diode_sod.measured: cathode on the left on 6 / 6 golden-set parts (SOD-123, -323, -523, LL-34)

diode_molded.measured: cathode on the left on 6 / 6 golden-set parts (SMA, SMB)

tantalum.measured: no rule: + on the left on 1, on the right on 2 of 3 golden-set parts

elec_can.measured: no rule: + on the left on 2, on the right on 1 of 3 golden-set parts

sot23_5.measured: no rule: pin 1 bottom-left (...-BL) on 2, bottom-right (...-BR) on 1 of 3 golden-set parts

sot223.measured: no rule yet: 1 golden-set part (pin 1 bottom-right)

qfn.measured: no rule: pin 1 top-left (...-TL) on 4, bottom-left (...-BL) on 1 of 5 golden-set parts

crystal_4pad.measured: no rule yet: 1 golden-set part (pin 1 bottom-left)
